qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: CRTC mandated wholesale fiber unbundling, 4-carrier wireless price war (Quebecor/Freedom Mobile), and high capital intensity keep ROIC depressed at 4-6% (well below the 12% hurdle), eliminating pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC 4-6% vs 12% hurdle; CRTC mandated wholesale access and aggressive 4th-carrier mobile competition erode pricing power).
qualitative.evidence: BCE's 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~4-6%, well below the 12% threshold, with recent write-downs pushing GAAP metrics negative. The Canadian telecom regulatory environment (CRTC mandated wholesale fiber access) and intense 4-player price competition (Quebecor/Freedom Mobile) have produced chronic wireless ARPU deflation. Elevated debt load (>CAD 40B net debt, ~4.5x net debt/EBITDA) and heavy FTTH capex led to a dividend reset in 2025, confirming structural capital allocation and pricing power failure.
